declaration.goal: Move ahead by about 0.45 m and stop there, keeping the heading within 12 degrees of the start heading.
declaration.measured_by: Computed from the simulator's pose, as the quantities a camera straight above could measure; not measured from a camera image. The camera sees a floor area of 2.59 m by 1.46 m. x, y and heading are relative to the start of each trial: x in the direction the body faces at the start, y to its left, heading counter-clockwise seen from above, in (-180, 180]. At the start the body is at x = 0, y = 0, and the view spans x from -0.84 to 1.74 m and y from -0.73 to 0.73 m. A value is lost when the camera could not see the tracked point.

statement.author: dr-kiro
statement.text: WHEN exactly one of the constant levels a2, a3, a4 is 1 and all other levels are 0 for the whole trial, THE system SHALL change x by at least 0.05 m in magnitude for at least one of them.

title.author: dr-kiro
title.text: Each of c2, c3, c4 held at 1 alone moves the body

title.author: dr-kiro
title.text: Each of c2, c3, c4 held at 1 alone moves the body

words.author: dr-kiro
words.text: c2, c3, c4 each held at 1 alone: x -0.035, -0.006, -0.007 m; heading -0.2, -2.9, -1.2 deg. Body settles within about 0.1 s and stays put. P1 (a3=1, x in [0.05, 3.0]) missed. Constant single inputs give no travel.

statement.author: dr-kiro
statement.text: WHEN all five channels carry a sine of amplitude 1 at 2 Hz with phase step 2*pi/5 between neighbouring channels, THE system SHALL end with x above 0.05 m.

title.author: dr-kiro
title.text: A phase-shifted sine on all channels drives the body forward

title.author: dr-kiro
title.text: A phase-shifted sine on all channels drives the body forward

words.author: dr-kiro
words.text: Travelling-wave sines on all channels: x -0.33 (2 Hz, 72 deg step), -0.30 (2 Hz, in phase), -0.10 (1 Hz). Heading ended at +68, -117, +132 deg. The body spins and drifts back, no forward travel. P1 (x in [0.05, 3.0]) missed.

statement.author: dr-kiro
statement.text: WHEN c1 is held at -1 and the other channels are 0 for the whole trial, THE system SHALL move the body forward by 0.1 to 0.4 m and turn it clockwise by 20 to 60 degrees.

title.author: dr-kiro
title.text: c1 at -1 drives the body forward and c0 adjusts heading

title.author: dr-kiro
title.text: c1 at -1 drives the body forward and c0 adjusts heading

words.author: dr-kiro
words.text: c1=-1 alone: x +0.113 m, heading -35 deg (P1 x in [0.1,0.4] hit; P2 heading in [-60,-20] hit). x grows linearly at about 0.0225 m/s while heading falls about 7 deg/s. c0=+1 or -1 added changes x by under 0.013 m and heading by under 5 deg, so c0 is nearly inert. Forward travel exists but is too small and comes with a large turn.

statement.author: dr-kiro
statement.text: WHEN c1 is held at -1 and c2, c3, c4 are all held at 1, THE system SHALL end with x above 0.2 m.

title.author: dr-kiro
title.text: c2, c3, c4 held together change how c1 = -1 moves the body

title.author: dr-kiro
title.text: c2, c3, c4 held together change how c1 = -1 moves the body

words.author: dr-kiro
words.text: c1=-1 with c2=c3=c4=+1: x 0.062, heading -135 deg. With c2=c3=c4=-1: x -0.26, heading +122 deg, but the body drove ahead at about 0.2 m/s for the first 1.5 s (x peaked at 0.236) while turning about -45 deg/s, then circled back. P1 (x in [0.2, 1.5]) missed for both. The three channels together add a strong turn, so the circling hides any forward drive.

statement.author: dr-kiro
statement.text: WHEN c1 = -1, c2 = -1, c3 = -1 and c0, c4 are 0 for the whole trial, THE system SHALL end with x above 0.2 m.

title.author: dr-kiro
title.text: Dropping c4 from the c2, c3, c4 = -1 drive reduces the turn and keeps the forward push

title.author: dr-kiro
title.text: Dropping c4 from the c2, c3, c4 = -1 drive reduces the turn and keeps the forward push

words.author: dr-kiro
words.text: c1=-1, c2=-1, c3=-1, c4=0: x -0.263, y -0.317, heading +116 deg. This is almost the same path as c4=-1 (E4 T11), so c4 has little effect here. The body drives ahead for about 1.5 s, then circles back. P1 (x in [0.2, 1.0]) missed. The last trial does not meet the goal (x about 0.45 m, heading within 12 deg). The budget is used up.
